boundary_rationale: The row opens on a fresh title-stack formula, oshb:Jer.9.6 = web:Jer.9.7, לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הִנְנִ֥י צוֹרְפָ֖ם וּבְחַנְתִּ֑ים (oshb:Jer.9.6, byte tier) — ‘lachen koh amar YHWH tsevaot, hineni tsorfam u-vchantim,’ ‘therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies, behold, I will melt them and test them’ — following immediately on the ne'um-YHWH close before it, and reprising the arrow-image of deceit, “Their tongue is a deadly arrow. It speaks deceit” (web:Jer.9.8). The mourning for the burned pastures, “I will weep and wail for the mountains, and lament for the pastures of the wilderness” (web:Jer.9.10), leads into the closing verdict, oshb:Jer.9.10 = web:Jer.9.11, וְנָתַתִּ֧י אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֛ם לְגַלִּ֖ים מְע֣וֹן תַּנִּ֑ים (oshb:Jer.9.10, byte tier) — ‘ve-natati et Yerushalayim legalim, me'on tanim,’ ‘and I will make Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling place of jackals’ — before the address turns, at 9.12, to a question about who can understand the ruin, opening a different mode.
strongest_rejected_alternative: The mourning for the land at 9.10 could open its own short row as a fresh first-person turn, but its addressee stays the one already established at 9.7, so it is kept inside this unit.
wj_or_red_letter_considered: not applicable in the OT substrate
device_notes: A ketiv/qere note sits at oshb:Jer.9.7 = web:Jer.9.8 (single-witness), inside the offset zone. Setumot bound the row at oshb:Jer.9.5, immediately before it, run through it at oshb:Jer.9.8, and close it at oshb:Jer.9.10 (single-witness, WLC).
